newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat pushed higher in short covering.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat pushed higher in short covering.

text.p: KCBT hard red winter wheat futures were pushed higher in active midsession dealings on short covering, traders said.
"Refco's bought 1.5 million Dec. That's pushed us up another two to three cents (per bushel) from where we were," a KCBT trader said.
Traders said they had seen a steady stream of short covering Monday, ahead of Tuesday's USDA November crop report.
"It's not really buying but a lack of selling that's helping us," a trader said.
At 1108 CST, KCBT wheat was four to seven cents per bushel higher, with Dec up seven cents at $4.23 a bushel. KCBT Dec had been as much as 11 cents higher in the minutes after Refco bought.
Traders said General Mills bought 500,000 Dec bushels and 1.2 million March. Man International sold 900,000 March. Prudential Securities bull-spread 400,000 Dec/March bushels at 28 cents.
